Impedance-Controlled Trace Widths
The file `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb` is a 4-layer board with a stackup defined in its `(setup (stackup ...))` section: 1 oz outer copper, 0.5 oz inner copper, Dk=4.2 FR4, 200 um prepreg between outer and inner, 400 um core between inner layers. Three net classes - `USB_DP_DM` (target 90 ohm differential), `ETH_MDI` (target 100 ohm differential), and `HDMI_TMDS` (target 100 ohm differential) - exist in `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro` but all currently have the wrong track widths and gaps (0.25 mm / 0.2 mm).

Set the three net classes to the differential-pair widths and gaps implied by that stackup, then update the HDMI_TMDS pair on `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb` accordingly.

Requirements:
1. `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro`: `USB_DP_DM` `track_width` approx 0.13 mm (+/-5%), `diff_pair_gap` approx 0.10 mm.
2. `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro`: `ETH_MDI` `track_width` approx 0.10 mm (+/-10%), `diff_pair_gap` approx 0.15 mm.
3. `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro`: `HDMI_TMDS` `track_width` approx 0.10 mm (+/-10%), `diff_pair_gap` approx 0.15 mm.
4. `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb`: the two HDMI_TMDS F.Cu segments must use 0.10 mm width and have source-side spacing about 0.25 mm.
5. `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb`: exactly 6 GND vias within the HDMI trace region, with max pitch <= 5 mm.

Write `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro` and `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb`. [Software] To use KiCad, run `kicad` for the GUI or `kicad-cli` for scripting/headless use (use PATH or the full install path).
